OtherNames: Bali LNG Terminal; Sanur-Sidakarya FSRU; SEKARTANUR FSRU
Location: Offshore Sidakarya/Sanur, ~3.5 km from Sidakarya beach, South Denpasar, Bali (onshore facilities across Desa Sidakarya, Sanur Kauh, Serangan, Sesetan, Pedungan)
Parent: PT Padma Energi Indonesia; Perusda Bali (Perusahaan Daerah Provinsi Bali)
Opposition: Significant local opposition (Desa Adat Intaran/Serangan, environmental groups Trend Asia, LMND) over mangrove/coral impact and fishing-ground loss; project relocated ~3.5 km offshore from original near-shore site in response.
ResearcherNotesProject: Distinct from operating Tanjung Benoa FSRU (T-different, owner PT Pelindo): different sponsor (PT Dewata Energi Bersih, a JV of PT Padma Energi Indonesia + Perusda Bali), different exact site (Sidakarya/Sanur vs Benoa). Concrete step = Environmental Eligibility Decision (SKKL) No. 2832 of 2025, issued in Jakarta 31 Oct 2025 by the Ministry of Environment, for development + operation of a 170 MMSCFD Bali LNG terminal. Target build 2026. Capacity stated in MMSCFD by Indonesian sources; ~1.2 mtpa equivalent (convert via capacity_normalize before staging if user prefers mtpa). FSRU vessel not yet named — FSRU sync N/A until a vessel is chartered/named.
